name: Homestead Furniture
old_description: Homestead is furniture you experience, not scroll past. Made-to-order pieces. Real materials. Thoughtful design—guided by conversation, not a cart.
about:
Homestead Furniture operates from a three-floor showroom in Mt Hope, Ohio, where it has served customers for over 35 years. The company presents itself as a destination for custom furniture, emphasizing a consultative approach over transactional sales.

The business offers made-to-order hardwood and upholstered pieces, coordinating everything from hand-applied finishes to tailored dimensions. It carries multiple brands — including Abner Henry — and provides in-house design consultation, delivery, and assembly. The showroom spans curated residential and commercial vignettes, allowing clients to experience materials and scale in person.

Clients range from homeowners furnishing living rooms and dining areas to interior designers specifying custom pieces for commercial projects such as an optometric practice and a coffee shop. Homestead ships to all 50 states and 10 countries, though the bulk of its engagement appears to begin with an on-site or virtual design conversation.

The company frames customization as its founding principle rather than a recent add-on, positioning the design dialogue as the core of its process. Testimonials highlight bespoke items like a live-edge walnut bar sourced from a record-setting tree and a 108-inch dining table with pull-out leaves.
